en: Colorized historical street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story bourgeois buildings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn carriage is visible on the right. Shop signs such as "Kaufhaus Adolf Lassmann & Co." and "Max Baumann" appear on the corner building. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds. Printed titles at the top read "Döbeln i. S." and "Bahnhofstraße."
